name: terminal-browser
description: A browser that runs in the terminal, inside Claude Code: preview sites and HTML documents, and let the agent drive the built-in browser. Terminal only; it draws nothing on the desktop.

agentTool.title: Give the agent a tool that opens and closes terminal-browser
agentTool.description: Adds an open and close tool the model can call to show a page in the browser pane. Off by default.
